inlines.v: HE'BREW, noun [Heb. Eber, either a proper name, or a name denoting passage, pilgrimage, or coming from beyond the Euphrates.] One of the descendants of Eber, or Heber; but particularly, a descendant of Jacob, who was a descendant of Eber; an Israelite; a Jew. 1. The hebrew language. HE'BREW, adjective Pertaining to the Hebrews; as the hebrew language or rites.
